sentences: From January, {20 million|twenty million} homes get {£100,|a hundred pounds,} and yours could miss out.
Yesterday's Budget pays it to homes in England, council tax bands A to D.
Not by income. Not by energy bill. Just by your band.
Your band is set by what your home was worth in {1991.|nineteen ninety-one.}
So a big earner in a small flat still gets the {£100.|hundred pounds.}
A family in a band E house gets nothing… unless their council helps.
So when you hear the {£100|hundred pounds} is for everyone, remember:
